description: This file defines the DocumentBusinessEventSerializer class, which serializes document-related business events into an Avro DTO format. It handles both 'created' and 'deleted' document events, retrieves document data, maps it, and prepares it for external messaging or storage.

classes.name: DocumentBusinessEventSerializer
classes.description: A Spring component responsible for serializing document-related business events into Avro format, supporting creation and deletion events, and mapping document data accordingly.

methods.name: canSerialize
methods.description: Determines if the serializer can handle the given business event, specifically 'created' or 'deleted' document events.

methods.name: toAvroDTO
methods.description: Converts a business event into an Avro serializer-compatible DTO, retrieving and mapping document data as needed, building the Avro object.

methods.name: getSupportedSchema
methods.description: Returns the class of the supported Avro schema, which is DocumentDataV1.
